summary: Iteration 15 - AEON Personality Engine v3 Testing. New AeonMind class tested for mode detection (buddy/coach/trader/mystic). 48/50 tests passed. Mode detection working correctly for casual chat, stress/life questions, trading questions, and philosophical questions. Energy matching verified - short messages get short replies. Bot stays on topic - doesn't randomly switch subjects. Telegram webhook integrates properly with new personality system.

minor.issue: Mystic mode scoring too conservative - 'how does manifestation work? is it about energy?' detected as buddy instead of mystic. Scoring threshold for mystic mode (>20) might be too high.

Mixed trading+mystic messages sometimes flip to mystic - 'what's the energy on bitcoin today?' detected as mystic instead of trader with blend. Trading signals should have priority when coin is mentioned.

OPTIONAL: When coin is mentioned, prioritize trader mode over mystic mode even with energy/vibe words
